question.text: Ms. Sunita Patil (CA, empanelled SIA) is conducting the pre-engagement compliance check for Pragati Foundation, an education NPO planning a ZCZP issuance on NSE-SSE. She must verify the registration under which section of the Income Tax Act that grants the NPO its tax-exempt status before she can accept the SAS-100 limited-assurance mandate?

answer.text: Section 12AB — fresh registration (replacing 12AA); provisional 3 years, subsequent 5 years
Section 11 — because Section 11 itself contains the NPO's registration certificate
Section 80G — since 80G is the only exemption route available to an NPO
Section 10(23C) only — because charitable status is granted exclusively under 10(23C)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** All NPOs (trusts, societies, Section 8 companies) must be registered under Section 12AB of the Income Tax Act to claim exemption of income under Section 11. The 12AB registration replaced the earlier 12AA regime vide CBDT notification dated 26 March 2021. Provisional registration is granted for up to 3 years and subsequent registration is for 5 years (renewable). The SIA must sight a valid 12AB certificate before accepting the engagement, since an unregistered NPO loses exemption and its reported 'impact spends' may actually be taxable — a material issue for the Annual Impact Report. **The Trap:** Section 11 grants the exemption but does not itself register the entity — registration is a separate step under 12AB. Section 80G is about donor-side deduction, not NPO-side exemption. Section 10(23C) covers specified institutions (approved educational/medical entities) but is not the general registration route for all NPOs. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A (MF Distributor) tests 80G from the donor side; X-A/X-B (Investment Adviser) tests CSR and 80G advice for HNI clients. XXIII frames 12AB registration as a pre-engagement checklist item for the SIA, not as tax planning advice. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Always ask for (a) the 12AB certificate with validity dates, (b) the most recent ITR-7 acknowledgement and (c) the auditor's report Form 10B. If the 12AB registration lapsed during the reporting period, disclose it as a scope limitation in your SAS-100 assurance statement.
